units.source_text: 忽然想起了京中的紫姬，如今西出阳关，隔离更远，思慕之心更切了。

en.t: Suddenly he thought of Lady Murasaki in the capital; now that he had gone west beyond the pass, the distance between them was greater, and his longing for her grew all the more intense.

units.source_text: 有时心绪不佳，想道：“怎么办呢？

en.t: At times, when his spirits were low, he would think, “What am I to do?

units.source_text: 真是古歌所谓‘方知戏不得’了。

en.t: This is truly what the old poem meant by only now realizing that love was no game.

units.source_text: 索性悄悄地把她迎接到这里来吧。”

en.t: Perhaps I should simply bring her here in secret.”

units.source_text: 继而又想：“无论如何，总不会经年累月地离居。

en.t: Then he thought again, “In any case, surely we will not go on living apart for years and months.

units.source_text: 如今岂可再做引人物议之事？”

en.t: How could I now do something again that would draw people’s criticism?”
With that, he calmed himself down.
